title: On the Record with John D'Agostino ft. Sebastian Bea (President & CIO at ReserveOne)
description:
John D’Agostino sits down with Sebasitian Bea, President and CIO of ReserveOne, for a conversation that goes straight to where institutional crypto is heading.

From his years at BlackRock to his leadership in crypto, Sebastian has seen every type of market cycle. He explains why this moment is different, why ReserveOne’s team is positioned to deliver a multi-asset Digital Asset Treasury (DAT) designed for institutional scale, and why the next wave of institutional capital is finally poised for the taking.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.
